answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jade of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, converted to a slow vesting stream, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the wander until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jetty of the next round.
